title: The Best Robot Lawn Mowers
subtitle: Wire-free and boundary-wire robot mowers with app control, ranked.
intro: We pulled the robot lawn mowers on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: wire-free navigation, lawn size, and all-wheel drive.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

buyers_guide.a: Older robots need a wire buried around the lawn edge. Newer wire-free models use RTK GPS, LiDAR, or cameras to map the lawn, which saves hours of setup.

buyers_guide.q: How big a lawn can it handle?
buyers_guide.a: Check the rated area and the slope it can climb. Buy for your lawn size with some headroom.

buyers_guide.q: Is it safe around kids and pets?
buyers_guide.a: Robot mowers have lift and obstacle sensors and stop the blades, but keep kids and pets off the lawn while it runs, and schedule it for times the yard is empty.
